comment:
* This implementation uses HttpEngine to send requests and receive responses. * This class may use multiple HttpEngines to follow redirects, authentication * retries, etc. to retrieve the final response body. * *

What does 'connected' mean?

* This class inherits a {@code connected} field from the superclass. That field * is not used to indicate whether this URLConnection is * currently connected. Instead, it indicates whether a connection has ever been * attempted. Once a connection has been attempted, certain properties (request * header fields, request method, etc.) are immutable. * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: fixedContentLength
variables.comment: Like the superclass field of the same name, but a long and available on all platforms.

variables.name: responseHeaders
variables.comment: Lazily created (with synthetic headers) on first call to getHeaders().

variables.name: route
variables.comment:
* The most recently attempted route. This will be null if we haven't sent a
   * request yet, or if the response comes from a cache.

variables.name: handshake
variables.comment:
* The most recently received TLS handshake. This will be null if we haven't
   * connected yet, or if the most recent connection was HTTP (and not HTTPS).

methods.comment:
* Returns the value of the field at {@code position}. Returns null if there
   * are fewer than {@code position} headers.

methods.name: public final String getHeaderField(String fieldName)
methods.comment:
* Returns the value of the field corresponding to the {@code fieldName}, or
   * null if there is no such field. If the field has multiple values, the
   * last value is returned.

* Aggressively tries to get the final HTTP response, potentially making
   * many HTTP requests in the process in order to cope with redirects and
   * authentication.

methods.name: private boolean execute(boolean readResponse) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Sends a request and optionally reads a response. Returns true if the
   * request was successfully executed, and false if the request can be
   * retried. Throws an exception if the request failed permanently.

methods.name: public final boolean usingProxy()
methods.comment:
* Returns true if either: *
    *
  • A specific proxy was explicitly configured for this connection. *
  • The response has already been retrieved, and a proxy was {@link * java.net.ProxySelector selected} in order to get it. *
* *

Warning: This method may return false before attempting * to connect and true afterwards.
